_comment: Task 1.7: systems of mire. Offsets in light-years from the region center (D12). Planets come in tasks 1.8 and 1.9.

systems.name: Murk (WIP)
systems.notes: Red supergiant glowing through the dust cloud, the only star of the Mire seen directly.

systems.name: Slough (WIP)
systems.notes: Red dwarf hidden in the cloud, known only from the lanes that lead to it.

bodies.notes: Where ships go into the Mire to hide.
bodies.gmNotes: The Unlit move through the Mire's shifting lanes, which may be how they reach the Deeps and the Hollows without the one-way lanes. This is one of their anchorages.

bodies.name: Tarn mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 7-day lane to Tarn (drifting: its exit point wanders and a recent chart is needed).

bodies.name: Deeps mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 4-day lane to the Deeps (tidal: open about two weeks in every seventy-three days).

bodies.name: Hollows mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 5-day lane to the Hollows (tidal: open about two weeks in every seventy-three days).

places.name: Drowned hull (WIP)
places.notes: A ship that came out of the Mire somewhere it never meant to go, half sunk in a bog.
